verdict.rationale: LM Studio's first-party pages present Bionic as a built-in agent you can work with to create and edit documents and run 'advanced agentic tasks', and a hands-on user reports it 'works great'. The documented scope of what can be delegated is thin marketing copy, and the user notes rough edges (unclear working directory, no preload or unload). Bionic is also described as a separate app. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of which task types Bionic can carry out autonomously, evidence of tool use or multi-step execution inside Bionic, and confirmation that it is integrated into the core LM Studio app rather than shipped separately.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Work with Bionic to create and edit documents. Every change is automatically saved, so you can work with your agent freely.
use them for simple chats or advanced agentic tasks
